# Ferreteria del Sur

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Uruguayan online hardware store selling power and hand tools, construction, paints and chemicals, locksmith items, electrical, lighting, plumbing, garden and automotive tools. Ships to all of Uruguay, with pickup in San Jose de Mayo and Montevideo.
